caption: The drawing features a single metallic object set against a plain beige background. The object consists of a long, slightly curved handle with a circular loop at one end and a flat, rectangular blade at the other. The blade is attached to the handle with a thick collar and is oriented at an angle to the handle. The entire object is depicted in shades of brown and rusty red, suggesting a metallic material with visible wear, corrosion, and patina. The blade has irregular patches of darker coloration, while the handle appears more uniform in color, with slight shading indicating depth. There are no additional objects or intricate details in the background, which remains blank except for some minor discolorations.
title: Hawsing Iron
